title: Adopted bytes must equal probed bytes — manifest-verify every copy boundary
summary: Contrastive-probe adoption must verify sha256 manifests at every copy boundary, not just copy from a snapshot.
reusable_steps: Contrastive-probe adoption must verify sha256 manifests at every copy boundary, not just copy from a snapshot
expected_outcome: When an agent materializes an auto_advance winner overlay onto the next round base, source it from the staged snapshot — never the live overlayDir. Under an unsandboxed scenario command every verification point is a window: (1) hash bytes AS READ into the run dir (copyTreeHashed), not a second read; (2) re-verify snapshot AND current-base manifests before copying; (3) re-hash the materialized tree and require it to equal base-manifest overridden by snapshot-manifest; (4) carry the verified manifest into the next round so a mutation in the verify->next-manifest window is recorded, not silently re-baselined. Failure mode at each step: materialization_error halt with the reason mirrored into the round record and the report.
